r3b3.scope: Focused owner/host lifecycle contract, not final Belaya release or full browser acceptance

root_cause.manager: Original WeakMap keyed only by disposable host; cleanup deleted its entry. New host could not receive captured view. WeakMap semantics are correct; ownership boundary was too short-lived.
root_cause.streamlit: Installed Streamlit component frontend key is generated per mount, unsuitable for persistence identity. Selected UI emitted st.empty before later component rendering, introducing an avoidable clearing transition. Historical runtime evidence established host replacement; this task does not claim that empty delta is the sole possible replacement cause.

fix.owner: Stable keyed Python container selected-realistic-owner-<generation revision>; removed on Plotly or empty result. Frontend resolves its DOM ancestor outside the component shadow root.
fix.state: WeakMap keyed by owner DOM element; snapshot only position, target, userCamera, front and outlines after cleanup. Different owner or room resets. No scene-wire field, session state mutation, browser storage or generic global ID cache.
fix.cleanup: Snapshot before disposal; active-entry ownership check and idempotent disposed flag prevent old cleanup overwriting new state. Detached hosts/owners cannot replace a live scene. Legacy callers retain host-local semantics.
fix.resources: Existing 250 ms asset pool grace unchanged; no retained renderer/mesh/controls after cleanup; late asset completion cancellation retained.

initial_regression.expected_failure: New-host viewState null instead of saved snapshot

tests.limits: Lifecycle resources/canvases in deterministic tests are instrumented mount doubles; actual scene cleanup remains corroborated by ordinary-browser markers and existing pool/native tests. No universal memory-leak or GPU memory proof. Full Python, packaging and CI not run.
